questions.question: b753 has stopped at the lock. The lock gate read its 8 gates passing and refused the lock on (R345)(2)(iv): two relay commits after v1.33.0's own (7c91353a) touched tools/standing/ and left VERSION unmoved, 0f31d31d (chain.py, v1330.py) and 0db31ce3 (roster.py, [M1]). Your sixth word (4) ordered that state: the version stays v1.33.0 and its bank names each such commit with the controls run after it, which the bank does. The gate has no exemption for a bank's naming; the lock route refuses a gate record that does not permit; and a VERSION move made now is refused as well, being after the gate commit 236a6af0. The seat did not read this gate against your sixth word when it carried it, and letters that as its own. The refused gate's two outputs are kept in scratch and nothing is locked. Any route writes after this refused run and before the lock; the seat reads N4's lock gate as the run that permits the lock. How should the lock proceed?

options.label: Read the two as covered (Recommended)
options.description: A tool of this act's name, committed before it runs, runs b378's lock gate unedited except that its (R345)(2)(iv) list leaves out 0f31d31d and 0db31ce3, the two commits the v1.33.0 bank names. The lift and the two ids are printed in the gate's notes and banked as an event. The version stays v1.33.0 and no standing tool changes.

options.label: Move VERSION alone to v1.33.1
options.description: Against your sixth word (4). VERSION moves alone, no tool's code changed, and its bank is written for v1.33.1. The after-the-gate check still refuses that commit, so it needs the same kind of lift for that one commit. N2's clause that the standing version lands before the gate reads REFUTED.

options.label: Hold the act at the lock
options.description: Nothing further is written. The seal, the root and the pushes wait for your own route.
